Name: (AT) Wyrd's Seasonal Mailbox
Author: lianace
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds one mailbox, that changes with the seasons. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20720]The original mod for Content Patcher (default building replacement) can be found here[/url]﻿, by logwyrd.

This is an AT mod, it does not change the default buildings. It adds extra options that you can customize objects with after having bought the paintbucket from Robin.

Credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56947462]logwyrd [/url]for the textures, all I did was convert their work to AT.[/size]
